body.x: CIT Co., Ltd. (CEO Seung Jeong) participated in the ‘2025 ICT Convergence Expo Korea (ITCE 2025),’ held concurrently with ‘FIX 2025 (2025 Future Innovation Tech Expo)’ at EXCO from Tuesday, October 22, to Saturday, October 25.

CIT (Copper Innovation Technology) is a domestic startup that has been developing electronic materials for ultra-high-speed communication, centering on its core technology, ASE (Atomic Sputter Epitaxy), which significantly improves the transmission efficiency of electrical signals since 2023.

The ASE method allows for the alignment of copper (Cu) atoms at a level of one trillion per cubic centimeter. CIT explained that this achieves the industry’s highest transmission efficiency, supporting a maximum speed of 10 Gbps for wired connections and a frequency range of 1 to 100 GHz for wireless connections.

This high-efficiency substrate manufacturing technology raises expectations even further, especially in the AI (Artificial Intelligence) era, where data transmission volumes and power requirements are rapidly increasing. CIT is also seeking to pioneer the next-generation AI semiconductor market by developing ‘CuFlat-PKGCore™,’ a board for next-generation AI accelerators.

CuFlat-PKGCore™ is a product that deposits ultra-flat copper on a glass substrate using the ASE method, characterized by maximizing the purity of the conductor input into the substrate to 100% copper. While existing substrate manufacturing required a multi-step process, including seed layer formation, electroless plating, electroplating, and CMP, CIT succeeded in significantly shortening that complexity with a single ASE process.

Despite this simplification, it achieves a surface roughness of 4 nm or less, a 7% lower surface resistance. It enables uniform deposition even on a glass substrate with a high aspect ratio of 8:1. Furthermore, since oxidation does not occur even when reaching temperatures 2.5 times higher than that of conventional copper. It can uniformly maintain the performance of the AI accelerator in environments where vast amounts of power are input.

body.x: In addition, CuFlat-PKGCore™ offers greater design freedom for boards due to its high copper atom density and uniform alignment, ensuring broad compatibility with glass substrates of various materials. Furthermore, its environmental friendliness is highly valued, as it does not generate chemical wastewater during the manufacturing process and allows the use of recycled copper scrap.

Building on these strengths, CIT earned recognition for its strong potential in the next-generation AI semiconductor market, followed by selection for the Innovation Award in the ICT Convergence sector at the Future Innovation Tech Expo (FIX).

CIT stated, “CuFlat-PKGCore™ is a product that meets the needs of the semiconductor industry in various aspects, including performance and efficiency, as well as flexibility, versatility, and sustainability.” The company continued, “As the development of advanced industries accelerates daily with the vision for next-generation technologies like AI, autonomous driving, and 6G ultra-high-speed communication, we expect the practical demand for the product also to increase.”

The company then conveyed its ambition, “As we seek to make a full-scale entry into the global semiconductor market, we are pleased to achieve an award at FIX 2025, the Korean version of CES, while gaining industry-wide attention.” They added, “Riding on this momentum, we will challenge for an Innovation Award at CES 2026, held in Las Vegas, USA, early next year, and use it as an opportunity to gain recognition for our worldwide competitiveness once again.”

FIX 2025 is an ‘Integrated Innovation Technology Platform’ that showcases the latest technologies in future mobility, robotics, AI (Artificial Intelligence), and semiconductors in one place. The exhibition, running under the slogan ‘The Future Already Begun, All on AI,’ consisted of industry-specific exhibitions, conferences, business programs, side events, and cultural tourism programs, including the Daegu International Future Auto & Mobility Expo (Daegu International Future Auto & Mobility Expo), which exhibited eco-friendly mobility, future mobility, secondary batteries, and components. The Daegu Robot Expo (Daegu Robot Expo) showcased industrial robots, service robots, robot components, AR/VR, AI, IOT, and drones. The ICT Convergence Expo Korea (ICT Convergence Expo Korea) featured metaverse & platform, digital content & systems, smart devices, cybersecurity, and ICT convergence services. Startup platforms like the PNP KOREA EXPO 2025 (Plug and Play Korea Expo 2025), Startup Arena, and the Global Innovator Festa (GIF) were also prepared.
